description: Returns the monthly electricity balance of Georgia from the Georgian National Energy and Water Supply Regulatory Commission (GNERC): the generation by type of power plant, the import and the export by country, the supply, the consumption by group, the losses, the domestic consumption, and the transit, in million kWh, for one month from 2022-01, or the total of one year from 2022. GNERC publishes a month about three weeks after it ends. With no input, it returns the newest published month. A year that is not over holds only its published months: see months. Data from GNERC.

month.description: A month from 2022-01, as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-03. Leave month and year empty for the newest published month.

year.description: A year from 2022, for the total of the year. Do not give it with month.

name: energy_get_balance

as_of.description: The instant at which GNERC last changed the workbook, or at which the server read it, RFC 3339.

consumption.description: The consumption, which GNERC counts with the export and the losses. It equals the supply.

direct.description: The consumers connected to the transmission grid.

stopped_stations.description: The own use of the power plants while they stood still.

free_market.description: The suppliers of the free market. Absent before 2024.

public_service.description: The suppliers of the public service.

universal_service.description: The suppliers of the universal service.

domestic_consumption.description: The generation plus the import, less the export.

export.description: The export, by country of destination.

into_abkhazia.description: The part of the import that went into Abkhazia. Import only.

generation.description: The generation of the power plants.

solar.description: The solar power plants. Absent before 2025.

import.description: The import, by country of origin.

into_abkhazia.description: The part of the import that went into Abkhazia. Import only.

losses.description: The electricity that the grid operators bought to cover the losses of their grids.

months.description: The count of published months that the period holds: 1 for a month, up to 12 for a year.

newest_month.description: The newest month that GNERC published, YYYY-MM.

period.description: The month, YYYY-MM, or the year, YYYY, of the balance.

source.description: The source of the data: Georgian National Energy and Water Supply Regulatory Commission (GNERC).

stale.description: True when GNERC did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

station_own_use.description: The electricity that the power plants use or lose before the grid.

supply.description: The generation less the station own use, plus the import.

transit.description: The electricity that crossed Georgia to Turkey.

unit.description: The unit of each value: million kWh.

title: Get the electricity balance of Georgia
